Subject: Q1 Board packet draft + signoff timeline

Team — attaching the first-pass Q1 board/ investor slide deck. High level ask: please review and return line edits or slide comments by COB Wednesday 2/8 so I can fold changes and circulate v2 to legal and board. Key points to check:

- One-page company narrative slide (pinned) — does the growth narrative match ops/gtm priorities?
- KPIs slide — numbers are provisional (see metrics snapshot). Confirm definitions (ARR vs. billings).
- Risks & mitigations — add anything material to call out.

Attachments: [Attachment: Investor_Q1_Draft_v1.pptx (pptx, 1.8MB)]

My proposed timeline:
- 2/8: internal line edit close
- 2/10: legal review (kimberly)
- 2/13: leadership sign-off
- 2/15: final deck to board

If you have a hard hold on any slide (esp. funding ask / runway), flag now.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Communications, Redwood Inference

On Sun, 05 Feb 2028 at 09:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the first-pass Q1 board/ investor slide deck. High level ask: please review and return line edits or slide comments by COB Wednesday 2/8 so I can fold changes and circulate v2 to legal and board.

Thanks Mina — quick pass attached as comments. Main asks:

- Revenue KPI slide: replace "Forecast ARR" with "Committed ARR" and split out hosted vs. dedicated. I added numbers in the spreadsheet.
- Churn: include 90-day cohort retention (single row) — shows improvement after Optimize launch.
- Product roadmap slide: drop long-term items, call out two near-term launches (streaming perf and new quantization profile).

Attached: metrics snapshot with my notes. I can take the KPIs slide and update if someone else owns narrative.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Growth

Date: Thu, 09 Feb 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 Board packet draft + signoff timeline

Thanks for the notes — I agree with Marissa on splitting hosted vs. dedicated ARR. A couple quick clarifications:

- The ARR number in the deck is revenue recognized through 1/31; bookings for Feb (large enterprise commit) are not yet recognized — we can add a footnote or show pipeline split.
- Product metrics: streaming latency percentile (p99) improved by ~18% in Jan after kernel changes; I'll add a one-line callout.

I can update the KPIs slide and add a short pipeline footnote. Targeting EOD 2/10 for my update.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations

Team — quick governance note: please avoid including contract-level customer names in the public board deck (slide 7 has a client logo). Kimberly, can legal confirm whether we should use anonymized references or secure permission for logo use?

Also, for the risk slide, I pushed a suggested phrasing to avoid forward-looking promises around capacity for Dedicated customers — see my inline comments.

Folks — thanks for the quick turns. I combined the KPI updates (Aditya/Marissa) and governance notes (Lauren) into v2. Changes included:

- KPIs: split hosted vs. dedicated ARR; added 90-day retention cohort row
- Product: one-line latency improvement callout
- Legal: removed customer logo and adjusted risk language per Lauren's note

Attached: Investor_Q1_Draft_v2.pptx. Please review slide-level changes and reply with "signoff" or specific objections by COB 2/15. If I don't hear objections, I will consider this final and publish to the board folder.
